Rashi on Chullin 6a:11:1.english: To acquire - By means of a kinyan of chalifin (a symbolic act of exchange).

Rashi on Chullin 6a:12:1.hebrew: לפונדקא דיאי - שם העיר, ועמי הארץ היו וחשודין על הדמאי. ומשום דאייתינן לעיל בהמתן של צדיקים כו', נקט ואתי להנך שמעתא, דמיירי נמי בכי האי גוונא:
Rashi on Chullin 6a:12:1.english: To the inn of Ya'ei - This is the name of the town, and [its people] were common folk [unlearned in the laws of tithes] and suspect with regard to demai. And because we cited above [the discussion of] "the animals of the righteous," etc., [the Gemara] took hold of that and came to this passage, which likewise deals with a similar matter.

Rashi on Chullin 6a:12:2.hebrew: מצומקות - צלויות הרבה, לשון "מצטמק ויפה לו" דשבת (דף לז:):
Rashi on Chullin 6a:12:2.english: Shriveled - Roasted a great deal; [this is] the expression "[a dish that] shrinks and is improved thereby," from [tractate] Shabbat (37b).

Rashi on Chullin 6a:12:3.hebrew: ביין - ואח"כ ערבום וטרפום ביין, ואיכא ביין משום דמאי, והכא משום דליתיה בעיניה, וע"י תערובת אייתי לקמייהו לא חשו למילתא:
Rashi on Chullin 6a:12:3.english: In wine - Afterward they mixed them and beat them into the wine. And with wine [by itself] there would be concern because of demai, but here, since it is not present in its own recognizable form, and it was brought before them already as a mixture, they were not concerned about the matter.

Rashi on Chullin 6a:13:1.hebrew: אפשר - אי איתא דגזרו חכמים על תערובת דמאי, מסתייע מילתא דיגרום עון, שלא ישים על לבו דגזרו עליו, וישכח הגזרה ויאכל בשוגג:
Rashi on Chullin 6a:13:1.english: Is it possible - If it were true that the Sages decreed concerning a mixture of demai, that would support [the idea] that it would cause sin: [namely,] that a person would not keep in mind that they had decreed about it, and would forget the decree and eat it unwittingly.

Rashi on Chullin 6a:14:1.english: He searched and found - that they did not issue a decree [regarding mixtures of demai].

Rashi on Chullin 6a:14:2.hebrew: לתת לתוך המורייס - דסופו לאוכלו ליין זה על ידי תערובת דמורייס, וכן לתת לתוך אלונתית פוישו"ן, שנותן מים ויין ושמן אפרסמון, כדאמרינן במסכת עבודה זרה (דף ל.):
Rashi on Chullin 6a:14:2.english: To put into the murias - For he will ultimately consume this wine through its mixture with murias [a fish brine]. And similarly, to put [wine] into alontith - "poison" [an Old French gloss, meaning a drink] - into which one puts water, wine, and balsam oil, as we say in tractate Avodah Zarah (30a).

Rashi on Chullin 6a:14:3.hebrew: טחינין - מאכל של גריסין ותבלין מעורבין בו, וכן רסיסין מעדשים, אע"פ שסוף כל אלו לערב, הואיל ובאין לידו של חבר מעם הארץ בעינייהו שלא בתערובת, חייב להפריש דמאי אם ספק הוא, כגון שלקחו מעם הארץ, ואין צריך לומר משום ודאי, אם אמר לו המוכר לא הפרשתי מהם:
Rashi on Chullin 6a:14:3.english: Techinin (ground grains) - This is a food of cracked groats with spices mixed into it, and likewise "crushed [grains]" (risisin) are from lentils. Even though in the end all of these get mixed together, since they come into the possession of a chaver from an am ha'aretz in their own [unmixed] state, not yet as a mixture, he is obligated to separate demai from them if it is a matter of doubt - such as when he bought them from an am ha'aretz - and needless to say when it is a matter of certainty, if the seller told him, "I have not separated tithes from these."

Rashi on Chullin 6a:15:1.hebrew: והם עצמם - הלוקח מעם הארץ את האוכלין עצמן, אין צריך להפריש דמאי, הואיל ובתערובת בא לידו:
Rashi on Chullin 6a:15:1.english: And they themselves - One who buys the foodstuffs themselves from an am ha'aretz [a person not trustworthy about tithing] does not need to separate demai [tithes on produce that may not have been properly tithed], since it came into his possession as a mixture.

Rashi on Chullin 6a:16:1.english: To his neighbor - [Meaning] the wife of an am ha'aretz.

Rashi on Chullin 6a:16:2.english: Dough to bake - and he gave her leaven.

Rashi on Chullin 6a:16:3.hebrew: וקדרה לבשל - ונתן לה התבלין, אינו חושש שמא החליפה ונתנה משלה שאין מתוקן, לפי שאין חשודין על הגזל:
Rashi on Chullin 6a:16:3.english: Or a pot to cook - He gave her the spices; he is not worried that she switched them and gave [back] her own, which are not tithed, because they are not suspected of theft.

Rashi on Chullin 6a:17:1.english: Make [it] for me with my thrown-in ingredients - [this means] the leaven and the spice.

Rashi on Chullin 6a:17:2.hebrew: חושש - וצריך להפריש עליהם דמאי, ואע"ג דתערובת הוא:
Rashi on Chullin 6a:17:2.english: He is concerned - He must separate demai [tithes] from them, even though it is a mixture.

Rashi on Chullin 6a:18:1.hebrew: כיון דאמר לה עשי לי משליכי - הוי כמו שלקחן הימנה קודם תערובתן, ואח"כ צרפן, דהא ע"פ עשתה, ונעשית שלוחו:
Rashi on Chullin 6a:18:1.english: Since he said to her, "Make [it] for me from my own [flour]" - it is as though he had taken them from her before their mixture and afterward combined them, for indeed she acted at his instruction and became his agent.

Rashi on Chullin 6a:18:2.hebrew: וטעמא לא בטיל - לפי שהוא מתקן הכל והוא עיקר, ואפילו לקח קדרה מבושלת מעם הארץ שלא נעשה שלוחו כשעירבן, אסור, אבל יין במורייס ויין בביצים אינו עיקר:
Rashi on Chullin 6a:18:2.english: And the taste is not nullified - Because it improves everything and it is the primary component, and even if he took a cooked pot from an am ha'aretz [who is not trusted regarding tithes] who did not become his agent when he mixed it in, it is forbidden. But wine in fish-brine and wine in eggs is not the primary component.

Rashi on Chullin 6a:19:1.hebrew: ולחלופי לא חיישינן - דקתני אם נתן לה הכל, אין חוששין שמא החליפה:
Rashi on Chullin 6a:19:1.english: And we are not concerned about exchange - For it is taught: if he gave her everything, we are not concerned lest she exchanged it.

Rashi on Chullin 6a:19:2.english: One who gives [dough] to his mother-in-law - [This means] his dough, to bake [it].

Rashi on Chullin 6a:19:3.hebrew: מפני שחשודה מחלפת המתקלקל - אם יתקלקל הלחם מחליפתו, הלכך מעשר את שהוא נותן לה, דאי מיחלפא ליה, שלא יהא חבר זה נותן לפניה מכשול:
Rashi on Chullin 6a:19:3.english: Because she is suspected of exchanging the spoiled [dough] - If the bread becomes spoiled, she exchanges it. Therefore, he tithes what he gives her, for [it is a concern] lest it get exchanged on him, so that this associate (chaver) should not place a stumbling block before her.

Rashi on Chullin 6a:19:5.hebrew: התם כדקתני טעמא - דלטובה היא מתכוונת, אבל על הגזל, כגון לאדם נכרי, שאין דעתה להחליף להטיב לו, אף להרע אינה חשודה:
Rashi on Chullin 6a:19:5.english: There, as it teaches the reason - [It is] because she intends [to do] good. But with regard to theft, such as [stealing from] a non-Jew - since she has no intention of switching [the produce] in order to benefit him, she is also not suspected of [switching] in order to harm him.

Rashi on Chullin 6a:1:1.hebrew: ואי ס"ד לא קבלה - רבי זירא מרבי יעקב דר"ג לגמרי אסר, מאי קשיא ליה:
Rashi on Chullin 6a:1:1.english: And if it enters your mind that he did not accept it - [if you say] that Rabbi Zeira [understood] from Rabbi Yaakov that Rabban Gamliel prohibited it entirely, what difficulty would he have [in resolving it a different way]?

Rashi on Chullin 6a:1:2.hebrew: לישני ליה - לנפשיה, כי אסר ר"ג, כשאין ישראל עומד על גביו, דלית ליה "לפני עור לא תתן מכשול", וכי אכל רבי יוחנן, כשישראל עומד על גביו:
Rashi on Chullin 6a:1:2.english: Let him resolve it for himself - Rabban Gamliel's prohibition was stated in a case where a Jew was not standing over him [the Samaritan], for in that case there is no concern of "you shall not place a stumbling block before the blind." And when Rabbi Yochanan ate [from the Samaritan's slaughter], it was in a case where a Jew was standing over him.

Rashi on Chullin 6a:2:1.english: And put a knife to your throat - This is a verse in the book of Proverbs.

Rashi on Chullin 6a:2:2.hebrew: אם בעל נפש אתה - אם אדם כשר אתה, כדאמר בפסחים (דף מ.): בעל נפש לא ילתות, אדם כשר:
Rashi on Chullin 6a:2:2.english: If you are a ba'al nefesh - If you are a proper person, as it says in Pesachim (40a): "A ba'al nefesh does not soak [grain]" - [meaning] a proper person.

Rashi on Chullin 6a:2:3.english: Your throat - [Meaning] your cheeks. That is to say, restrain yourself against your [evil] inclination and do not do this.

Rashi on Chullin 6a:3:1.hebrew: מצאו להן - אותם היושבים בהר גריזים ונעשו מומרים לעבודת כוכבים. ואע"ג דרוב כותים לאו מהר גריזים היו, רבי מאיר לטעמיה דחייש למיעוטא, ביבמות (דף סא:): קטן וקטנה לא חולצין ולא מיבמין, דברי ר"מ. אמרו לו לר"מ: יפה אמרת לא חולצין, איש כתיב בפרשה, מפני מה לא מיבמין? אמר להן: קטן שמא ימצא סריס, קטנה שמא תמצא איילונית, ונמצאו פוגעים בערוה. ולא אמר רוב קטנים אינם סריסים:
Rashi on Chullin 6a:3:1.english: They found for themselves - Those who dwelled on Mount Gerizim and became apostates for idol worship. And even though most Samaritans (Kuthim) were not from Mount Gerizim, Rabbi Meir is consistent with his own reasoning, that he is concerned for the minority, [as taught] in [tractate] Yevamot (61b): A minor boy and a minor girl do not perform chalitzah and do not perform levirate marriage (yibum) - these are the words of Rabbi Meir. They said to Rabbi Meir: You have said well that they do not perform chalitzah, since "a man" is written in that passage - but why do they not perform yibum? He said to them: A minor boy - lest he be found to be a eunuch; a minor girl - lest she be found to be infertile (aylonit) - and they would then be found to be engaging in a forbidden relation. And he did not say that most minors are not eunuchs [and rely on that majority].

Rashi on Chullin 6a:4:1.english: a ruler over you - [Meaning] a great [scholar] in Torah.

Rashi on Chullin 6a:5:1.english: If he knows about his teacher - [Meaning,] that if he asks him, he will give him the reason.

Rashi on Chullin 6a:5:3.hebrew: ואם לאו תבין את אשר לפניך - מעצמך, ואל תשאל ותביישנו, ושמת סכין בלועך בתריה דהאי קרא כתיב, כלומר התחזק עצמך ועצור פיך מלשאול:
Rashi on Chullin 6a:5:3.english: And if not, "consider well what is before you" - [figure it out] on your own, and do not ask him and thereby embarrass him. "And put a knife to your throat" is written right after this verse, meaning: strengthen yourself and restrain your mouth from asking.

Rashi on Chullin 6a:5:4.english: If you are a person of conscience - and you desire to ask and get to the bottom of the matter, what is his remedy? Separate yourself from him.

Rashi on Chullin 6a:7:1.hebrew: מהתם גזרו - ר"מ על היין, ורבן גמליאל אחריו על השחיטה:
Rashi on Chullin 6a:7:1.english: From there they decreed - Rabbi Meir [decreed] concerning wine, and Rabban Gamliel after him concerning slaughter.

Rashi on Chullin 6a:7:2.hebrew: וקבלו מינייהו - לא שאלו גדולים הימנו, אלא שבדורו של ר"מ לא רצו לקבל עליהם לפרוש מן הכותיים לפי שהיו רגילים בהם, ובדורו של רבי אמי היה אפשר להם לפרוש:
Rashi on Chullin 6a:7:2.english: And they accepted [it] from them - It is not that they asked [permission] from those greater than themselves; rather, in the generation of Rabbi Meir (R"M), they were unwilling to accept upon themselves to separate from the Samaritans (Kuthim), because they were accustomed to them, whereas in the generation of Rabbi Ami it was possible for them to separate.

Rashi on Chullin 6a:8:1.hebrew: לבטל רשות - אם דר כותי במבוי, צריך לשכור את רשותו, ואפילו נתן להם במתנה אינה מבוטלת עד שישכור, והיינו כעובד כוכבים. וישראל ששכח ולא נתן בערוב עם בני המבוי, והוא דר עמהם ואוסר עליהם, מבטל להם רשותו, ועובד כוכבים עד שישכור ישראל הימנו. וטעמא מפרש בהדר את העובד כוכבי' (דף סט:):
Rashi on Chullin 6a:8:1.english: To nullify [one's] right of possession - If a Samaritan (Kuthite) lives in an alley, one must rent his right of possession from him; and even if he gives it to them as a gift, it is not nullified until they rent it - and this is treated like [the law of] a non-Jew (star-worshipper). And a Jew who forgot and did not contribute to the eruv with the people of the alley, and he lives with them and thereby forbids [carrying] for them, may nullify his right of possession to them - but a non-Jew's [right is not nullified] until a Jew rents it from him. And the reason is explained in [the chapter] "One who lives with a non-Jew" (69b).

Rashi on Chullin 6a:9:1.hebrew: משמר שבתו בשוק - בפרהסיא, אעפ"י שהוא מומר לחללו בצנעה, הרי הוא כישראל, ואם לא עירב עם שכניו בחצר או במבוי, נותן להם רשותו ודיו:
Rashi on Chullin 6a:9:1.english: Who keeps his Sabbath in the marketplace - Publicly - even though he is an apostate who desecrates it in private, he is [treated] like [an ordinary] Jew; and if he did not join with his neighbors in an eruv for the courtyard or the alleyway, he [need only] give them his right [of use], and that suffices.

Tosafot on Chullin 6a:16:1.hebrew: אינו חושש לשאור ותבלין שבה לא משום מעשר ולא משום שביעית - משמע דתבלין חייבין במעשר. ותימה, דבפרק בא סימן (נדה נ.) תנן: כל שחייב במעשר מטמא טומאת אוכלים. ובהעור והרוטב (לקמן חולין דף קיז:) תנן: והקיפה מצטרפין לטמא טומאת אוכלין, וקאמר בגמרא: מאי קיפה? תבלין. אלמא תבלין אין להם טומאת אוכלין אלא על ידי צירוף, אע"ג דחייב במעשר. ויש לומר דמשום מעשר דקאמר הכא לא קאי אתבלין, אלא אשאור. ושביעית קאי אף אתבלין, דהא במאכל בהמה נמי נהגה שביעית:
Tosafot on Chullin 6a:16:1.english: One need not be concerned about the leaven or the spices in it, neither on account of tithes (ma'aser) nor on account of the Sabbatical year (shevi'it) - This implies that spices (tavlin) are obligated in tithes. And this is astonishing, for in the chapter "Ba Siman" (Niddah 50a) we learned: whatever is obligated in tithes conveys food-impurity (tumat okhlin). And in [the chapter] "Ha'or veHarotev" (below, Chullin 117b) we learned: "and the kipah combine to convey food-impurity," and the Gemara says: what is "kipah"? Spices. This indicates that spices have no food-impurity status except through combination [with other food, to reach the requisite measure] - even though they are obligated in tithes. And one can say that the word "tithes" stated here does not refer to spices at all, but rather to the leaven; while "the Sabbatical year" applies even to spices, since animal fodder, too, is subject to the Sabbatical year [restrictions].

Tosafot on Chullin 6a:2:1.hebrew: אשכחיה ההוא סבא - י"מ דכל מקום שהוא מזכיר "ההוא סבא" הוא אליהו, ואי אפשר לומר כן בפרק "במה מדליקין" (שבת דף לד.) בעובדא דרבי שמעון בן יוחאי:
Tosafot on Chullin 6a:2:1.english: A certain old man found him - Some explain that every place where it mentions "a certain old man" (ההוא סבא), it is Eliyahu. But it is not possible to say this in the chapter "Bameh Madlikin" (Shabbat 34a), in the incident involving Rabbi Shimon ben Yochai.

Tosafot on Chullin 6a:3:1.english: On the peak of Mount Gerizim - According to the Midrash, this is the idol that Jacob buried under the terebinth on the mountain of Shechem (Genesis 35).

Tosafot on Chullin 6a:5:1.hebrew: אם בעל נפש אתה פרוש הימנו - דבסיפא דקרא כתיב "ואל תתאו למטעמותיו":
Tosafot on Chullin 6a:5:1.english: If you are a person of desire (ba'al nefesh), keep away from it - For in the latter part of the verse it is written: "and do not desire his delicacies" (Mishlei 23:3).
